definitions.explanation: The state of interpersonal relations between people; how well people get along with each other.

examples.english: They are on good terms. / They get along well.
They are on bad terms. / They don't get along.
That couple seems to get along well.

notes:
{仲|なか} refers to the relationship or terms between people.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仲|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to be on good terms
- ⟦{仲|なか}が{悪|わる}い→仲が悪い：25621_nakagawarui⟧: to be on bad terms
- {仲|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|よ}さそう: to seem to get along
- ⟦{仲|なか}{良|よ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧: on friendly terms, amicably
- ⟦{仲|なか}{直|なお}り→仲直り：03127_nakanaori⟧: reconciliation

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: companion, friend
- ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧: mediation

NOTE: Different from ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ (inside, middle).
